about: Which characters of the nth whitespace-separated word to highlight: the word without the quotes or punctuation around it, as [start, end) offsets in the text (UTF-16 code units). null for a word that is only punctuation (a dash, "..."), which isn't spoken as a word, so the previous word stays highlighted.

cases.name: quotes and punctuation are left out
an ellipsis on its own isn't a word
a dash on its own isn't a word
apostrophes and hyphens stay inside a word; brackets don't
